stages.headline: Our number system is decimal: 10 units of any place make 1 unit of the next place.
stages.headlineEnglish: Our number system is decimal: 10 units of any place make 1 unit of the next place.

stages.headline: Any number can be written as a sum of place units.

stages.headline: If a place has no units we write 0 there: zero holds the place.

stages.headline: Write in digits: 5 thousands 3 tens 7 units.
stages.headlineEnglish: Write in digits: 5 thousands 3 tens 7 units.
stages.problemText: Write in digits: 5 thousands 3 tens 7 units.
stages.solutionSteps: 1. Thousands 5, hundreds 0, tens 3, units 7. 2. The number is 5 037.

stages.headline: How many tens are there in 2 608 altogether?
stages.headlineEnglish: How many tens are there in 2 608 altogether?
stages.problemText: How many tens are there in 2 608 altogether?
stages.solutionSteps: 1. Drop the units digit 8. 2. What is left is 260 tens. 3. 2 608 = 260 · 10 + 8.
stages.solutionStepsEnglish: 1. Drop the units digit 8. 2. What is left is 260 tens. 3. 2 608 = 260 · 10 + 8.
